primary_source_citation.title: U.S. Forest Service & NOLS Wilderness Medicine Technical Reference: S-T-O-P Protocol & Survival Priority Ladder (Rule of 3s)

1.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Remember S-T-O-P (Sit, Think, Observe, Plan) and the Rule of 3s: 3 hours without shelter in cold rain kills far faster than 3 days without water.
core_mechanism_bullets: 1. S - SIT Down Immediately & Breathe: Panic is the #1 wilderness killer; sit down for 5 full minutes, drink water, eat a snack, and calm your heart rate.
2. T - THINK Through Timeline & Assets: Inventory your Ten Essentials, daylight hours remaining before sunset, weather trend, and the trip plan left at home.
3. O - OBSERVE Terrain & Natural Shelter: Scan for wind-protected high dry ground away from widowmaker dead limbs, dry flash-flood washes, and avalanche chutes.
4. P - PLAN Before Dark (Rule of 3s): Prioritize (1) First Aid, (2) Insulated Shelter before dark (3 hr rule), (3) Fire & Water (3 day rule), (4) Distress Signals.
1.worked_field_example: Step 1: Read the official Wilderness Survival Requirement 1 prompt carefully and underline every action verb. Step 2: Apply the field rule of thumb (Remember S-T-O-P (Sit, Think, Observe, Plan) and the Rule of 3s: 3 hours without shelter in cold rain kills far faster than 3 days without water.). Step 3: Verify each measurement or checkpoint against U.S. Forest Service & NOLS Wilderness Medicine reference criteria and record your findings in your Scout Workbook.
1.counselor_tabletop_demo: 3-Minute Troop Tabletop Demo (Req 1): Display wilderness_survival_stop_rule_of_3s_v46_diagram.png on screen, divide Scouts into buddy pairs for a 90-second hands-on walkthrough of 'S-T-O-P Protocol & Survival Priority Ladder (Rule of 3s)', and have each pair state the key threshold (Remember S-T-O-P (Sit, Think, Observe, Plan) and the Rule of 3s: 3 hours without shelter in cold rain kills far faster than 3 days without water.) in their own words before sign-off.
1.real_world_connection_box: U.S. Forest Service & NOLS Wilderness Medicine Field Standard: Remember S-T-O-P (Sit, Think, Observe, Plan) and the Rule of 3s: 3 hours without shelter in cold rain kills far faster than 3 days without water.

2.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Cold damp ground steals heat 25x faster than still air via conduction: 6 inches of compressed dry leaves underneath beats 3 roof layers.
core_mechanism_bullets: Conduction (Direct Ground Contact): Insulate underneath first with 6 to 8 inches of compressed pine boughs, dry leaves, or a closed-cell foam pad.
Convection (Wind Stripping Warm Air): Pitch low A-frame debris hut perpendicular to wind with 3-foot leaf walls and zero unnecessary dead air volume.
Radiation (Infrared Loss from Head/Neck): An uncovered head and neck radiate up to 30 to 40 percent of resting body heat in freezing air; put on an insulated beanie.
Evaporation (Sweat & Wet Cotton): Cotton loses 90 percent of insulation when wet ('Cotton Kills'); ventilate layers while building shelter so you never soak base layers.

3.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Rule of Threes for Distress: 3 whistle blasts, 3 signal fires in a triangle, and a signal mirror flash visible 10+ miles to aircraft.
core_mechanism_bullets: Signal Mirror Finger-V Sight (10+ Miles): Hold mirror near chin, bounce sunlight onto outstretched V-fingers framing the distant aircraft, and wiggle flash across cockpit.
Universal 3-Blast Whistle Signal: A pealess 115 dB plastic whistle carries 1 to 2 miles with minimal energy long after shouting destroys your voice.
Three Signal Fires in a Triangle: Daytime: heap green pine boughs on hot flames for thick white smoke; Nighttime: burn dry crisp wood on an open ridge.
High-Contrast Ground Symbols (30+ Ft): Trample or lay 30-foot-tall letters (minimum 6:1 length-to-width ratio): V = Require Assistance, X = Require Medical Help.

primary_source_citation.source_agency: CDC Backcountry Water Treatment Guide & EPA
primary_source_citation.title: CDC Backcountry Water Treatment Guide & EPA Technical Reference: Backcountry Water Disinfection Methods & Pathogen Protection

4.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: A rolling boil for 1 full minute (3 minutes above 6,500 ft elevation) kills 100 percent of viruses, bacteria, Giardia, and Cryptosporidium.
core_mechanism_bullets: Method 1: Rolling Boil (Gold Standard): 1 full minute at sea level (3 minutes above 6,500 ft) neutralizes all viruses, bacteria, Giardia, and Cryptosporidium oocysts.
Method 2: 0.1-Micron Hollow-Fiber Filter: Physically strains out bacteria (E. coli, Salmonella) and protozoa (Giardia, Crypto) immediately; pair with drops if viruses suspected.
Method 3: Chlorine Dioxide Tablets: Effective against viruses, bacteria, and Giardia in 30 minutes (wait 4 hours in cold turbid water for Cryptosporidium).
Pre-Filter Turbid Water Through Bandana: Always pour cloudy creek water through a clean cloth first so sediment does not clog filter pores or shield microbes.
